name: Equi-Ice

profile.name: Equi-Ice
profile.description:
Equi-Ice Is the simplest and most effective ice pack/ cold therapy product designed specifically for horses that provides direct delivery of ice to targeted areas. Equi-Ice is a durable and re-useable ice pack that delivers immediate benefits of direct icing to the horse’s spine and back muscles. Created by leading Australian equine physiotherapist, Tom Simpson (physiotom.com.au), Equi-Ice can be used routinely by horse owners to promote faster recovery post-exercise or injury.
Further information is available at www.equi-ice.com.au.  From Australia, call 1300  755 516. Email inquiries to info@equi-ice.com.au.
